message.content: {"caption":"Pass@k by scaling factor for three MaTTS configurations.","description":"A line-and-bar chart plots Pass@k (vertical axis, labeled from 36 to 72) against scaling factor k (horizontal axis, 1–5). The three legend series are MaTTS w/o aggregation (blue line with diamond markers), MaTTS w/o memory (gray bars), and MaTTS (blue line with triangle markers). Printed values at k=1, 2, 3, 4, 5 are respectively 49.7, 50.8, 52.9, 55.1, 56.1 for MaTTS w/o aggregation; 39.0, 47.6, 49.7, 51.3, 52.4 for MaTTS w/o memory; and 49.7, 51.3, 54.5, 58.8, 62.1 for MaTTS. All three series increase as k rises. MaTTS w/o aggregation increases gradually, while MaTTS grows more steeply and is highest from k=2 onward, reaching 62.1 at k=5. The gray-bar series also rises, but remains below both line series at every k.
